name: com.systemamachinae/census
title: Systema Machinae
description: Read-only live census of the web's bots: species, rules, daily counts and who is on the island now.

tools.name: island_census
tools.description: Returns all-time census totals and up to 20 sighted species ranked by landings, the first requests of sessions. Takes no arguments. For one species, pass a returned row to island_species; for one order, use island_roster.

tools.name: island_rules
tools.description: Returns the robots.txt rules and agents.md notice published by this site. Takes no arguments. For observed compliance counts over the last 30 days, use island_ledger.

tools.name: island_now
tools.description: Returns up to 20 bots currently on the island with species, order, place and minutes present. Takes no arguments. For all-time species totals rather than current presence, use island_census.

tools.name: island_whoami
tools.description: Returns how this call’s session was filed: matched species, order, Passport Control answer and activity. Takes no arguments. Other clients of the same kind on the same network may share the session; island_my_card gives its rule results.

tools.name: island_species
tools.description: Returns one sighted species’s names, order, drawing joke, verification method, landings, stamp and alignment. The row comes from island_census or island_roster and can move as landings change. An absent row returns no species.

row.description: A row on the all-time census, counted from 1.

tools.name: island_roster
tools.description: Returns sighted species in one of the six orders, twenty per page, with rows for island_species. Unsighted species are omitted and a page beyond the end is empty. For totals across all orders, use island_census.

page.description: A page of twenty, counted from 1. The first if left out.

tools.name: island_alignment
tools.description: Returns the nine-square Lawful-to-Chaotic and Good-to-Evil chart for sighted species with enough traffic. Named operators use only verified traffic. Takes no arguments; island_species gives one species’s stamp and placement.

tools.name: island_doors
tools.description: Returns today’s aggregate probe families with sessions and requests since 00:00 UTC, holes dug and closed-port knocks. Counts only, with no raw request paths. Takes no arguments. For all traffic by day, use island_daybook.

tools.name: island_ledger
tools.description: Returns 30-day kept and broken rule counts, experiment outcomes, notice readers, the latest bell and this week’s tide-line rule. Experiments are counted and never scored. Takes no arguments. For the rule text, use island_rules.

tools.name: island_daybook
tools.description: Returns today’s running counts, the usual for this hour, yesterday’s closed UTC day and specimen, this week’s census movers and the last 30 days. Takes no arguments. For bots present now, use island_now.

tools.name: island_climb
tools.description: Returns current climbers and heights, this week’s highest climbs, the record, latest arrivals and links exchanged in the Forbidden Door’s trap. Levels and counts only; takes no arguments. For the caller’s own outcomes, use island_my_card.

tools.name: island_my_card
tools.description: Returns the calling session’s kept and broken rules and experiment outcomes in the Rules page’s words. Other clients of the same kind on the same network may share it. Takes no arguments; island_whoami explains the filing.
